name: @red-cup-engineering/npm-registry-service
description: Builds the private npm registry from package sources, serves it over HTTP, and reads any npm registry back as a graph of packages, dependencies, and owners. Use when publishing packages to the registry, running a registry face, or asking what depends on what.

scripts.verify: node --check src/package-registry.mjs && node --check src/cloudflare-worker.mjs && node --check src/snapshot.mjs && node --check src/protocol.mjs && node --check src/registry-graph.mjs && node --check scripts/build-registry.mjs && node --check scripts/render-registry-graph.mjs && node --check scripts/serve-registry.mjs && node --check scripts/execute-a2a-task.mjs && node --check scripts/a2a-server.mjs && node --test test/*.test.mjs
